We’re running a short “Prospect Sprint” next week to batch product walkthroughs for engineering teams evaluating inference runtimes. Instead of separate 1:1s, we’re consolidating a 60-minute office-hours slot with multiple prospects so we can demo common integration patterns and answer infra questions live.

Proposed slot: Wednesday, Jun 14, 2028 — 15:00–16:00 ET (US)
Goals: quick 15-minute product recap, 25-minute open Q&A with breakout pairing, 20-minute live perf/cost walk using sample payloads.

Logistics notes:
- We’ll share a one-page agenda and participant list in advance.
- Host coverage: Ben will lead the demo, Soojin will handle infra/security questions, and I’ll moderate.
- If the proposed slot doesn’t work, share two alternatives and we’ll try to consolidate.

Attachments: prospect-sprint-agenda.pdf (draft), host-coverage.csv (internal roster)

Would love a quick RSVP from each of you and any specific topics you want us to cover (latency SLOs, KV cache, VPC/private deployment, costs).
